## Summary

The IEEE registry lists one MA-L block to "Gosuncn Technology Group Co., Ltd." [1] and one MA-M block to "Gosuncn Technology Group Co.,LTD." [2], both at 2819 KaiChuang Boulevard, Science Town, Huangpu District, Guangzhou. Gosuncn Technology Group, stock code 300098, has been established since 1997, is headquartered at that Guangzhou address, employs more than 3,300 people and describes itself as a smart-city Internet of Things products and services provider [3]. GlobalData lists its products as vehicle communication modules, electronic licence plates, automotive electronics, rail transit products, vehicle anti-theft and fleet management solutions and IoT modules [4], and EqualOcean names industrial-grade and automotive-grade cellular communication modules sold to OEM terminal makers, solution providers and system integrators [5].

A MAC in these blocks is most likely a cellular module or a vehicle or industrial terminal built around one; that the registry blocks go into these modules is inferred, not stated by a source [1][5]. The GosuncnWelink ME3630 is a 4G module supporting GSM, CDMA, W-CDMA, TD-SCDMA, LTE and TD-LTE with integrated GPS, designed for industrial routers, industrial PDAs, tablets and digital signage; TechInsights' public teaser does not name the chips inside [6]. CVE-2025-4536, published in May 2025, is a remotely exploitable information disclosure in the group's Audio-Visual Integrated Management Platform 1.0, a server product rather than a radio device [7].

Silicon, FCC grantee codes and randomization are not documented by the sources consulted; the FCC ID databases refused automated access from this session.
